question: The International Theatre Festival of India, Bharat Rang Mahotsav (BRM), held in Bengaluru from 1 February 2025 to 8 February 2025, was organised by which of the following institutions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National School of Drama**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bharat Rang Mahotsav (BRM)** is an annual International Theatre Festival organized by the **National School of Drama (NSD).**
 
• This prestigious event showcases the rich diversity of Indian and international theatre, bringing together artists, performers, and enthusiasts from around the globe.
 
• The **National School of Drama**, headquartered in **New Delhi**, is one of India's foremost institutions for theatre training and promotion.
 
• Established in **1959** by the **Sangeet Natak Akademi**, the NSD is now an autonomous organization under the **Ministry of Culture, Government of India.**
 
• The festival aims to promote cultural exchange, foster creativity, and serve as a platform for emerging and established theatre practitioners.
